mentions.description: A work-in-progress project by threetwoonezero: a procedurally generated civilisation, mostly inspired by Crusader Kings mechanics, in which character personalities drive most of the historical events. The author notes it has been a lot of fun to work on.
mentions.audience: Not explicitly stated in the source; plausibly players/readers interested in emergent-history simulations and fans of Crusader Kings-style mechanics.
mentions.author: threetwoonezero
